notes: Multi-turn eval for the chat agent. agent-eval.json cannot see any of this:
it posts one query to /search and reads the hits back, so every case there
starts from an empty filter state. The whole class of bugs measured here —
a filter set on turn 1 surviving, or correctly not surviving, turn 2 — is
invisible to it.
Each case is a session. Turns are posted in order to /api/agent/chat under
one sessionId, and only the LAST reply is scored. The turns before it exist
to build state, not to be judged.
Two checks, and they are opposites on purpose:
allCity    every hit sits in that city — a filter from an earlier turn
is still applied. Zero hits fails: an empty result proves
nothing about persistence.
multiCity  hits span two or more cities — a filter WAS dropped, because
this turn took it back in words.
A fix that satisfies every allCity case by never clearing anything would
fail all four multiCity cases. That is the point of carrying both.
retract-city-vn is a known failure, kept red on purpose. The model does not
emit clearFields for "đâu cũng được", and the grounding gate in
QueryExtractor.groundClearFields can only remove entries the model produced,
never add ones it did not. Teaching the prompt Vietnamese retraction phrases
was measured and cost 3 points on agent-eval.json across six unrelated
groups, so it was reverted. Delete this case only when the model itself
improves — not by widening the gate.

cases.why: The original bug. Turn 2 names no city, no date and no price, yet the model returned clearFields=[city,dateExpression,priceMax] and merge wiped London. Nothing in the sentence takes anything back.
A pure vibe refinement. Adding an atmosphere constraint must narrow the set, not reset where it is searching.
Two filters standing, only one vaguely addressed. 'Bigger' touches scale, not location.
State has to survive more than one hop. A gate that only inspects the latest turn against the latest extraction still has to hold here.
The follow-up is the vaguest phrasing in the set, and the one most likely to make the model re-extract from scratch.
The control for every persist case. An explicit retraction must still clear the filter, or the fix is just a filter that can never be unset.
KNOWN FAILURE. Same retraction in Vietnamese. The model emits no clearFields at all, so there is nothing for the gate to keep. See notes.
A retraction aimed at one slot must not take the others with it. Price goes, city stays.
Same shape on the date slot, and a second city so a hardcoded 'London' would not pass.
Picking a row off the list is navigation, not a new search. It must reach FOCUSED rather than re-running the query.
